raise_justifications.desktop/macos/Desktop/Sources/MainWindow: SB redesign: Omi-mark avatar on replies that spins while thinking (typing-dots suppressed for Omi's own replies) and tool-call chips gated to the streaming turn, merged with main's metadata-row reveal honoring keyboard focus (shared FocusState + testable ChatBubbleMetadataReveal); a component split is tracked follow-up.

Merging the Canonical Memory Atlas (rollout-gated full-page exploration view reachable from Memories, its own top-bar suppression) with main's DesktopTopBar redesign pushed the combined `mainContent` SwiftUI expression past the type checker's budget; split into `sidebarSlot`/`mainContentContainer`/staged notification-chain properties so each stays independently type-checkable. Follow-up: routing the Memory hub's Brain Map destination through MemoryGraphPresentationMode so canonical-cohort users get the atlas there instead of the legacy graph, plus the destination-local lifecycle load that establishes the cohort capability when Memories was never opened. Merging main's unified Memory navigation (#10541) carries in its hub-destination binding and readable-width adaptiveContent wrapper alongside this branch's atlas page state; a component split is tracked follow-up. Adds the undetermined-cohort branch so the Brain Map mounts neither surface before the capability is known; a transient legacy mount latched the shared graph view model and fired a destructive rebuild bootstrap. Also threads the clickable Brain Map connection/cited-memory navigation and the cohort-not-yet-known guard added since (commits 97a24cd2cf, f3af331013). The Brain Map hub tab now supplies the leave action Escape calls once the map has nothing of its own left to undo, so backing out of it lands on the hub rather than the dashboard; the key cannot travel up to the window instead because a canvas takes no focus (#10698).

Integration Connect telemetry: ImportConnectorSheet.startRun threads bounded run metrics (source/memory count buckets, was_first_sync, connector-native failure class) from the operation outcome to the runner's terminal emit; a component split is tracked follow-up.

Home ask bar now auto-grows as a multi-line TextField so long messages wrap instead of scrolling off-screen (+14 lines over the prior SB-redesign home/chat layout); a component split is tracked follow-up.

Bridge memory search now awaits the active initial or pagination projection before refreshing, preventing an immediate post-navigation marker search from using stale lifecycle capability state; merged with the rollout-gated Canonical Atlas inline entry point, which replaces the legacy Brain Map card main removed from this list. Memory detail moved from a modal sheet to a side panel matching the Brain Map inspector, which splits the page into a list column and a panel builder. Publishes canonicalLifecycleCapabilityEstablished so a presentation gate can tell "not canonical" apart from "not known yet". Also adds the memory detail provenance side panel and the same cohort-not-yet-known guard added since (commits abbaeb031d, f3af331013).

Adds CanonicalMemoryAtlasTabView (header-less hub-tab presentation), the single-active-type layout and small-atlas label/mark policies that keep a sparse atlas legible, and a deterministic single-type export fixture for that case. The private atlas surface and logger keep all of it in this file; splitting the surface from the layout engine is tracked follow-up. Also adds the sparse-atlas label flip (a name colliding below its mark is retried above instead of dropped, which on the real account recovered 8 of 10 anonymous entities) and the extracted nodeLabel it shares. Adds the MemoryAtlasDetailPanel inspector that replaces the navigate-away "View evidence" jump, net of deleting the inline card, its preview, and its empty state; splitting the surface from the layout engine is tracked follow-up. Adds the deterministic inspector export fixture (and the preview-selection seam it needs) so the panel is captured by an offscreen render rather than only described. Also carries the relatedness-based layout adoption, neighbourhood detection with named region captions, account-holder edge damping/draw-order tethering, and the region-caption type treatment plus hover affordance landed since (commits 680e54d767 through 213841afb0); splitting the surface from the layout engine remains tracked follow-up. Territories drawn as real coastlines, island-level captions written on the island, and layered Escape land here; the naming and geometry half of that — coastline hit testing, caption placement, the dismissal ladder — is split out into MemoryAtlasTerritoryLabels.swift in the same change, which is why this grows by ~180 rather than ~590. Review round: Escape walks one hop back along the selection trail instead of dropping it, the departure zoom is optional so a map-filling region offers no unreachable zoom-out exit, and the map leaves a neighbourhood whose id a graph rebuild removed.

Relatedness layout, Louvain neighbourhood detection, and the group-separation and anchor-repulsion forces the island map is built on; no baseline entry existed because the file crossed the threshold in this change. It is already separate from the atlas view — a further split of detection from simulation is tracked follow-up.
Suggested-task loading feedback is now overlaid outside the list flow so an initial fetch cannot shift the task rows; a component split is tracked follow-up.
SB redesign: adds the hover-expand AppNavRail (icons→labels) and the merged/simplified navigation (Memory, Insights) driving selectedIndex; a component split is tracked follow-up.
